state.label: State
state.description: What to decide about: a ticket, a record, a message. Text is sent as text; JSON is sent as structured state.
state.tooltip: Send the fields the questions need, not whole pages. Jev reads literally and large unrelated detail lowers accuracy.

questions.label: Questions
questions.description: JSON map of question id to a typed question. Answers come back under the same ids as data.answers.<id>.
questions.tooltip: choice: criteria is a map of option to description. score: criteria is an ordered list of at least two levels. noul: a yes/no question, criteria optional {true, false}.
